TC-20/S18.title: Both dashboards pass axe, and the counts sit in a live region
TC-20/S18.detail: Our own accessibility check (no UAT item or ticket asks for it: record only; findings are suggestions, Quinn 2026-10-14). axe-core wcag2a + wcag2aa on both dashboards: only color-contrast (serious): the row line 'Room 4B-18 · 1 task pending' / 'Cedar Wing · Room 18 · 0 tasks pending' 2.63:1 (#90a1b9 on white; known A4) and, new with the 640bc7c4 tabs, the unselected 'All Residents' tab label 4.34:1 (#62748e on #f1f5f9). The four tiles are inside <dl aria-live='polite' aria-label='Rounding status counts'> with the numbers in it; each row is a button whose name starts with the patient's name. Whether a screen reader announces a change is S20b (person).
